verses.text: \s1 Adam koehoi Abraham totouh
Adam, Seth, Enosh,
Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
Enok, Methuselah, Lamek,
Noah, Shem, Ham, hoi Japheth.
Japheth capanaw teh: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek hoi Tiras.
Gomer capanaw teh: Ashkenaz, Riphath hoi Togarmah.
Javan capanaw teh: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim hoi Rodanim.
Ham capanaw teh: Kush, Mizraim, Put hoi Kanaan.
Kush capanaw teh: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah hoi Sabteka. Raamah capanaw teh: Sheba hoi Dedan.
Kush ni Nimrod a sak teh ahni teh talai van dawk athakaawme kamtawng pasuek e lah ao.
Mizraim ni Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naptuhim a sak.
Pathrusim, Kasluhim teh Philistin hoi Kapthorim tâconae lah ao.
Kanaan ni a camin Sidon hoi Kheth,
Jebusit, Amor, Girgashite,
Arvad, Zemarit hoi Hamathite naw hah a khe.
Shem capanaw teh: Elam hoi Assyria, Arphaxad hoi Lud, Aram hoi Uz, Hul, Gether hoi Meshek.
Arphaxad ni Shelah hah a khe teh Shelah ni Eber a khe.
Eber ni capa kahni touh a khe, buet touh e min teh Peleg doeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hatnae se nah talai a kârei awh e lah ao. A nawngha e min teh Joktan doeh.
Joktan ni Almodad hoi Sheleph, Hazarmaveth hoi Jerah,
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
Ophir, Havilah hoi Jobab. Hetnaw pueng teh Joktan e capanaw doeh.
Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
Eber, Peleg, Reu,
Serug, Nahor, Terah,

Abram heh Abraham doeh.   
\s1 Abraham Catounnaw
Abraham capanaw teh Isak hoi Ishmael doeh.
Hetnaw teh Ishmael casaknaw doeh. Ishmael e camin teh Nebaioth doeh. Hahoi, Kedar, Adbeel hoi Mibsam,
Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
Jetur, Naphish hoi Kedemah. Ahnimanaw teh Ishmael casaknaw doeh.
Abraham e ado Keturah ca sak naw teh Zimran hoi Jokshan, Medan hoi Midian, Ishbak hoi Shuah, Jokshan casak teh Sheba hoi Dedan.
Midian casak teh Ephah, Epher, Enok, Abida hoi Eldaah. Hetnaw teh Keturah casaknaw doeh.
Abraham ni Isak a sak. Isak casaknaw teh, Esaw hoi Isarel.
Esaw casaknaw teh Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam hoi Korah.
Eliphaz casaknaw teh, Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna hoi Amalek.

Reuel casaknaw teh, Nahath, Zerah, Shammah hoi Mizzah.   
\s1 Seir imthung
Seir casaknaw teh: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer hoi Dishan.
Lotan casak naw teh: Khori, Homam hoi Lotan tawncanu Timna.
Shobal casaknaw teh: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho hoi Onam. Zibeon casaknaw teh: Aiah hoi Anah.
Anah casak teh: Dishon. Dishon casaknaw teh: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran hoi Keran.

Ezer casaknaw teh: Bilhan, Zaavan, Jaakan. Dishon casaknaw teh: Uz hoi Aran.   
\s1 Edom siangpahrangnaw
Isarel catounnaw dawk siangpahrang ao hoehnahlan vah, Edom ram e siangpahrangnaw teh, Beor capa Bela ao teh a khopui min teh Dinnabah doeh.
Bela a due hnukkhu teh Bozrah koehoi Zerah capa Jobab teh ahni yueng lah a uk.
Jobab a due hnukkhu ahni yueng lah Temani ram dawk hoi Husham ni a uk.
Husham a due hnukkhu ahni yueng lah Moab ram vah Midian ka thet e Bedad capa Hadad ni a uk. A khopui min teh Avith doeh.
Hadad a due hnukkhu ahni yueng lah Masrekah hoi Samlah ni a uk.
Samlah a due hnukkhu teh ahni yueng lah Rehoboth palang hoi Sawl ni a uk
Sawl a due hnukkhu teh ahni yueng lah Akbor capa Baalhanan ni a uk.
Baalhanan a due hnukkhu ahni yueng lah Hadad a bawi. A khopui min teh Pau doeh, a yu min teh Mezahab napui Matred canu Mehetabel doeh.
Hadad a due hnukkhu Edom khobawi lah kaawmnaw teh, khobawi Timna, khobawi Alvah, khobawi Jetheth,
khobawi Oholibamah, khobawi Elah, khobawi Pinon,
khobawi Kenaz, khobawi Teman, khobawi Mibzar,
khobawi Magdiel, khobawi Iram hetnaw teh Edom khobawi lah ao.
Isarel imthung hateh Reuben, Simeon, Levih, Judah, Issakhar hoi Zebulun,

Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad hoi Asher.   
\s1 Judah catoun
Judah casaknaw teh: Er, Onan hoi Shelah. Hate kathum touh teh Kanaan napui Bathshua hoi a sak e naw doeh. Er teh Judah e camin lah ao ei, BAWIPA mithmu vah tamikathout lah ao dawkvah a due sak.
A langa Tamar ni hai ahni hanlah Perez hoi Zerah a khe pouh dawkvah, Judah casak heh abuemlah panga touh a pha awh.
Perez casaknaw teh: Khetsron hoi Hamul.
Zerah casaknaw teh: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Khalkol hoi Dara hoi abuemlah panga touh a pha awh.
\x - \xo 2:7 \xt Josh 7. 1\x*Karmi casak teh Akhar doeh. Isarelnaw runae ka poe e, thoebo e ka parawt e Akhan doeh.
Ethan casak Azariah.
Khetsron casak Jerahmeel ni ahni hanlah Ram hoi Khelubai a sak pouh.
Ram ni Amminadab a sak. Amminadab ni Judah casak khobawi Nahshon a sak.
Nahshon ni Salma hah a sak teh Salma ni Boaz hah a sak.
Boaz ni Obed a sak teh Obed ni Jesi a sak.
Jesi ni a camin Eliab a sak. Apâhni lah Abinadab, apâthum lah Shimea,
apali nah Nethanel, apanga nah Raddai,
ataruk nah Ozem, asari nah Devit a sak.
A tawncanu hai ao teh Zeruiah hoi Abigail heh a tawncanu doeh. Zeruiah casak Abishai, Joab, Asahel hoi kathum touh a pha awh.
Abigail ni Amasa a sak. Amasa na pa teh Ishmael Jether doeh.
Khetsron capa Kaleb ni a yu Azubah hoi Jerioth koehoi ca a sak. Ahnie canaw teh: Jesher, Shobab hoi Ardon.
Azubah a due hoi Kaleb ni Epharath hah ama koe a la teh ahni hanlah Hur a sak pouh.
Hur ni Uri hah a sak teh Uri ni Bezalel a sak.
Hahoi Khetsron ni Gilead tami Makhir canu a ikhai teh, Khetsron hah a la teh kum 60 a pha toteh, Khetsron hanlah Segub a sak pouh.
Segub ni Jair a sak teh Gilead ram e khopui 23 touh hah ahnie lah ao.
Hatei, Geshur, Aram khocanaw hoi Jair, hotnaw thung hoi Kenath hoi a khotenaw, khopui 60 touh a la sin. Hotnaw pueng teh Gilead na pa Makhir casaknaw e doeh.
Hahoi Khetsron teh Kalebephratha kho dawk a due. Khetsron yu Abijah ni ahni hanlah Tekoa na pa Ashhur a sak pouh.
Khetsron e camin Jerahmeel casaknaw a camin Ram hoi Bunah, Oren hoi Ozem hoi Ahijah naw doeh.
Jerahmeel teh a yu bout a la teh, a min teh Onam manu Atarah doeh.
Jerahmeel camin Ram casaknaw teh Maaz, Jamin hoi Eker naw doeh.
Onam casak teh Shammai hoi Jada lah ao teh Shammai casak teh Nadab hoi Abishur lah ao.
Abishur e yu min teh Abihail doeh, ahni ni Ahban hoi Molid a sak pouh.
Nadab casak teh Seled hoi Appaimnaw doeh, Seled teh ca sak laipalah a due.
Appaim casak teh Ishi, Ishi casak teh Sheshan, Sheshan casak teh Ahlai.
Shammai e nawngha Jada casak teh Jether hoi Jonathan lah a o, Jether teh ca sak laipalah a due.
Jonathan casak teh Peleth, Zaza. Hetnaw teh, Jerahmeel casak lah ao awh.
Sheshan teh ca tongpa awm hoeh, napuinaw dueng doeh kaawm. Sheshan koevah, Izip san, a min lah Jarha ao.
Sheshan ni a canu teh a san Jarha koevah a yu lah a poe dawkvah ahni hanlah Attai a sak pouh.
Attai ni Nathan a sak teh Nathan ni Zabad a sak.
Zabad ni Ephlal a sak teh Ephlal ni Obed a sak.
Azariah ni Helez a sak teh Helez ni Eleasah a sak.
Eleasah ni Sismai a sak teh Sismai ni Shallum a sak.
Shallum ni Jekamiah a sak teh Jekamiah ni Elishama a sak.
Jerahmeel nawngha Kaleb casak Ziph na pa Mesha hah a camin teh Mareshah casak Hebron na pa lah ao.
Hebron casak teh Korah, Tappuah, Rekem hoi Shema doeh.
Shema ni Jorkeam na pa Raham a sak teh Rekem ni Shammai a sak.
Shammai casak Moan doeh, Maon teh Bethzur na pa doeh.
Kaleb e ado Ephah ni Haran, Moza hoi Gazez a sak. Haran ni Gazez a sak.
Jahdai casak teh Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah hoi Shaaph doeh.
Kaleb e ado Maakah ni Sheber hoi Tirhannah a sak.
Madmannah na pa Shaaph, Makhbena na pa Sheva hoi Gibea na pa hai a sak. Aksah heh Kaleb canu doeh.
Hetnaw heh Kaleb casak lah ao awh. Hur casak a camin lah Epharath lah ao teh, Kiriathjearim na pa Shobal.
Bethlehem na pa Salma, Bethgader na pa Hareph hai ao.
Kiriathjearim na pa Shobal casak thung hoi Manahati tangawn, Haroehnaw hai ao rah.
Kiriathjearim casak dawkvah Ithrite hoi Puthit, Shumati, Mishraitinaw ao awh teh, hetnaw koehoi Zorath hoi Eshtaol lah a tâco.
Salma casak Bethlehem, Netophah, Atrothbethjoab hoi Manahati tangawn Zorithnaw hah doeh.
Cakathutkungnaw casak lah kaawm e teh Jabez, Tirathites, Shimeathi hoi Shukathi doeh. Hetnaw heh Rekhab imthung e a na pa Khammath koehoi ka tâcawt e Keninaw doeh.
Hetnaw heh Devit casaknaw lah ao awh. Ahni hanlah Hebron vah Jezreel Ahinoam ni a camin Amnon a sak pouh. Apâhni lah Karmel Abigail ni Daniel a sak pouh.
Apâthum nah siangpahrang Geshur Talmai canu Maakah capa Absalom, apali nah Haggith capa Adonijah.
Apanga nah Abital capa Shephatiah, ataruk nah a yu Eglah capa Ithream,
Hebron vah hete capa taruk touh heh a sak toe. Hawvah, kum sari touh hoi thapa yung taruk touh a uk teh, Jerusalem vah kum 33 touh a uk.
Jerusalem vah a sak e naw teh: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon naw doeh. Ammiel canu Bathshua hoi pali touh a sak.
Hathnukkhu, Ibhar, Elishama hoi Eliphelet,
Nogah, Nepheg hoi Japhia.
Elishama, Eliada hoi Eliphelet, tako touh a pha awh.

Hetnaw pueng teh Devit casaknaw doeh, adonaw e casaknaw hai ao rah. Hahoi Tamar teh ahnimae tawncanu doeh.   
\s1 Judah siangpahrangnaw
Solomon casaknaw teh: Rehoboam, Rehoboam capa Abijah, Abijah capa Asa, Asa capa Jehoshaphat.
Jehoshaphat capa Joram, Joram capa Ahaziah, Ahaziah capa Joash,
Ahaziah capa Amaziah, Amaziah capa Azariah, Azariah capa Jotham.
Jotham capa Ahaz, Ahaz capa Hezekiah, Hezekiah capa Manasseh.
Manasseh capa Amon, Amon capa Josiah.
Josiah casak teh a camin he Johanan, apâhni lah Jehoiakim, apâthum lah Zedekiah, apali lah Shallum.

Jehoiakim casaknaw dawk, Jehoiakim capa Jekoniah, Jekoniah capa Zedekiah.   
\s1 Devit catounnaw
San lah kaawm e Jekoniah casak dawk, Jekoniah capa Shealtiel.
Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama hoi Nedabiah.
Pedaiah casak teh Zerubbabel hoi Shimei, Zerubbabel casak teh Meshullam hoi Hananiah hoi a tawncanu Shelomith.
Hashubah hoi Ohel, Berekhiah hoi Hasadiah, Jushabhesed hoi panga touh a pha awh.
Hananiah casak teh Pelatiah hoi Isaiah, Rephaiah casak, Arnon casak, Obadiah casak, Shekaniah casak.
Shekaniah casak teh Shemaiah, Shemaiah casak teh Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, Shaphat hoi taruk touh a pha awh.
Neariah casak teh Elioenai, Hezekiah, Azrikam hoi kathum touh a pha awh.
Apâthum e Elioenai casak koehoi Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, Anani hoi sari touh a pha awh.
Judah casak teh Perez, Khetsron, Karmi, Hur, Shobal.
Shobal capa Reaiah ni Jahath a sak. Jahath ni Ahumai hoi Lahad a sak. Hetnaw teh Zorath e casaknaw doeh
Etam na pa e canaw teh Jezreel, Ishma hoi Idbash doeh, a tawncanu min teh Hazzelelponi doeh.
Gedor na pa Penuel hoi Hushah na pa Ezer. Hetteh Bethlehem na pa Epharath e camin Hur casak doeh.
Tekoa na pa Ashhur heh a yu kahni touh, Helah hoi Naarah a tawn.
Ahni hanlah Naarah ni Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, Haahashtari a sak pouh. Hetnaw heh Naarah casak lah ao.
Helah casaknaw teh: Zereth, Zohar hoi Ethan.
Koz ni Anub hoi Zobebah a sak teh Harum capa Aharhel casak lah ao.
Telah ao navah, Jabez teh a hmaunawnghanaw thung dawk minhmai khet e tami lah ao. A manu ni reithai nalaihoi ka khe e doeh ati teh, a min teh Jabez a phung.

Jabez teh Isarel Cathut koevah, Yawhawi na poe roeroe haw, ka ram teh kaw sak haw, na kut hoi na awmkhai nateh, lungmathoenae kai koe a pha hoeh nahanelah, yonnae thung hoi na hlout sak haw, telah a hram teh, ahni ni a hei e hah a poe.
Shuhah e a nawngha Kelub ni Eshton na pa Mehir a sak.
Eshton ni Bethrapha, Paseah, Nahash khopui na pa Tehinah a sak. Hetnaw heh Rekah taminaw doeh.
Kenaz casaknaw teh: Othniel, Seraiah. Othniel casak teh Hathath.
Meonothai ni Ophrah a sak teh Seraiah ni Gekharashim na pa Joab a sak.
Jephunneh capa Kaleb casak teh Iru, Elah hoi Naam, Elah e capa teh Kenaz doeh.
Jehallelel casak teh Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria hoi Asarel.
Ezrah casak teh Jether, Mered, Epher, Jalon doeh. Miriam ni Shammai hoi Eshtemoa na pa Ishbah a khe pouh.
Ahnie yu Jehudijah ni Gedor na pa Jered, Sokoh na pa Heber, Zanoah na pa Jekuthiel a sak. Hetnaw teh Mered ni a la e Faro canu Bithiah canaw doeh.
Hodiah yu casak teh Karmi Keilah na pa Naham tawncanu hoi Maakath Eshtemoa doeh.
Shimon casak teh Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, Tilon. Ishi casak teh Zoheth hoi Benzoheth.
Judah capa Shelah casak teh Lekah na pa Er, Mareshah na pa Laadah doeh. Ashbe imthung dawk teh loukloukkaang e lukkarei ka sak thai e hai ao.
Jokim hoi Kozeba tami hoi Joash, Moab vah yu ka lat e Seraph hoi Jashubilehem. Palang thut e naw doeh.

Hetnaw teh Netaim hoi Gederah vah kho ka sak e hlaam ka bo e naw doeh, siangpahrang koe tawngtang kho a sak awh.   
\s1 Simeon caksak
Simeon casak teh Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Sawl.
Sawl capa Shallum, Shallum capa Mibsam, Mibsam capa Mishma.
Mishma casak lah, Mishma capa Hammuel, Hammuel capa Zakkur, Zakkur capa Shimei.
Shimei te capa hlaitaruk touh hoi canu taruk touh ao awh ei, a hmaunawnghanaw teh ca moi tawn awh hoeh. Hatdawkvah, ahnimae canaw pueng teh Judah casak patetlah la pung awh hoeh.
Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,
Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
Bethmarkaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, Shaaraim vah kho a sak awh. Hetnaw heh Devit a bawi nah totouh ahnimae khopui lah ao.
Ahnimae khotenaw teh Etam, Ayin, Rimmon, Tokhen, Ashan hoi kho panga touh.
Ahnimae khote pueng teh khopui tengpam vah Baal totouh ao awh. Hetnaw teh khosaknae lah ao awh teh, a napanaw e konglam thut e hai a tawn awh.
Meshobab, Jamlekh hoi Amaziah capa Joshah.
Joel hoi Asiel casak Seraiah, Joshibiah capa Jehu.
Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel hoi Benaiah.
Shiphi capa Ziza, Allon capa Shiphi, Jedaiah capa Allon, Shimri capa Jedaiah, Shemaiah capa Shimri.
Hete a min kaawm e naw teh casaknaw ka hrawi e lah ao teh, imthung teh moikapap a kamphung awh.
Ahnimanaw teh Gedor kâennae tanghling kanîtholah totouh saringnaw pâ nahane tawng hanelah a cei awh.
Saringnaw pâ nahane, hram ca hane kahawipoung e ram lah a hmu awh. A ram a kaw teh karoumcalah onae hmuen lah ao. Hmaloe la kaawm e teh Ham catounnaw doeh.

Hetteh Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah tue navah a min hoi a thut e naw doeh kamnuek. Hatnavah, ahnimae rimnaw hoi Mehunimnaw teh a thei awh teh atu totouh hote hmuen koe ao awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, saringnaw a pâ nahanlah ao dawkvah.
Simeon casak tami 500 touh hane Seir mon dawk a luen awh. Hatnavah Ishi canaw Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah hoi Uzziel tinaw teh a lû lah ao awh.
Amalek miphun, ka yawng e naw dawk hoi kaawm e naw hah a tâ awh teh, atu totouh kho a sak sin awh.
\s1 Reuben casak

Isarel e camin teh Reuben e capanaw katang doeh. Hateiteh, a na pa e ikhun a khin sak dawkvah, camin lah a onae hah Isarel e capa Joseph e capanaw koe poe e lah ao. Hatdawkvah, setouknae dawk camin lah a onae hah pakhum e lah awm hoeh.
Judah teh a hmaunawnghanaw hlak a tha a sai teh, ahni dawk hoi kaukkung a tâco. Camin lah a onae teh Joseph ni a coe.
Isarel camin Reuben e casaknaw teh Hanok, Pallu, Hezron hoi Karmi.
Joel casak teh, a capa Shemaiah, Shemaiah capa Gog, Gog capa Shimei.
Shimei capa Maikah, Mikah capa Reaiah, Reaiah capa Baal.
Baal capa Beerah. Ahni teh Reuben e khobawi lah ao eiteh, Assyria siangpahrang Tiglathpileser ni san lah a hrawi.
Amae a nawngha Jeiel hoi Zekhariah, ahnimouh roi teh ca catoun separuinae pakhumnae dawkvah, imthungnaw kahrawikung lah ao.
Azaz capa Bela, Shema capa Azaz, Joel capa Shema ni Aroer hoi Nebo Baalmeon totouh kho a sak.
Kanîtholah Euphrates palang hoi kahrawng thung kâennae totouh, a coe awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Gilead ram dawk saringnaw hah a pungdaw toe.

Sawl se navah Hagri miphunnaw hoi a kâtuk awh teh, Gilead kanîtholah totouh, rimnaw dawk kho a sak awh.   
\s1 Gad casak
Gad e casaknaw teh avangvanglah Bashan ram dawk Salkah totouh ao awh.
Bashan vah a lû lah Joel, apâhni lah Shapham, Janai hoi Shaphat tinaw doeh.
A na pa imthung hoi a hmaunawnghanaw Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jakhan, Zia, Eber hoi sari touh a pha awh.
Hetnaw teh Huri capa Abihail e capanaw doeh. Ahni teh Jaorah capa doeh. Gilead capa, Michael capa, Jeshishai capa, Jahdo capa, Buz capa lah ao.
Guni capa, Abdiel capa, Ahni teh imthung kahrawikung lah ao.
Hatdawkvah, Gilead hoi Bashan khotenaw tengpam e ram pueng khori totouh kho a sak awh.
Hote hnonaw pueng teh, Judah siangpahrang Jotham e se hoi Isarel siangpahrang Jeroboam e se teh setouknae dawk thut lah ao toe.
Reuben casak, Gad casak, hoi Manasseh miphun tangawn dawk hoi tarankahawinaw, bahling, tahloi ka patuem thai e naw, likathoumnaw, taran ka tuk thai e naw 44, 760 touh a pha awh.
Hatnavah, Hagri, Jetur, Naphish hoi Nodabnaw hoi a kâtuk awh.
Kâtuk nahaiyah Cathut koe a hram awh teh, ama a kâuep awh dawkvah, ahnimouh teh a kabawp awh. Hatdawkvah, Hagrinaw hoi ahnimouh koe kaawm e abuemlah a kut dawk hoi a rungngang awh.
Saringnaw a man pouh awh teh, kalauk 50000, tu 250000, hoi la 2000 hoi tami 100000 a la awh.

Tarantuknae teh Cathut e lah ao dawkvah, tami moikapap a due awh. San toung totouh a onae hmuen koe ao awh.   
\s1 Manasseh miphun tangawn
Manasseh miphun tangawn teh, haw e ram dawk kho a sak awh. Bashan hoi Baalhermon hoi Senir hoi Hermon mon totouh tami teh a pungdaw awh.
Hetnaw heh a imthungnaw kahrawikung lah a o: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, Jahdiel. Ahnimanaw teh tami a thakaawme, min kamthang e, imthung kahrawikung lah ao awh.
Mintoenaw e Cathut koe yuemkamcu awh hoeh dawkvah, ahnimae hmaitung Cathut ni a raphoe teh, hote ram dawk e cathutnaw koe a kâyo awh.

Hottelah Isarel Cathut ni Assiria siangpahrang Pul, Assiria siangpahrang Tiglathpileser e lungthin a tho sak teh, Reuben hoi Gad, Manasseh miphun tangawn hah san lah a man awh teh, Halah, Habor, Hara tinaw hah Gozan palang a ceikhai awh teh atu totouh ao awh.
Levih casaknaw teh: Gershon, Kohath hoi Merari.
Kohath casaknaw teh: Amram, Izhar, Hebron hoi Uzziel.
Amram casaknaw teh: Aron, Mosi hoi Miriam. Aron casaknaw teh: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar hoi Ithamar.
Eleazar ni Phinehas a sak teh Phinehas ni Abishua a sak.
Abishua ni Bukki a sak teh Bukki ni Uzzi a sak.
Uzzi ni Zerahiah a sak, Zerahiah ni Meraioth a sak.
Meraioth ni Amariah a sak, Amariah ni Ahitub a sak.
Ahitub ni Zadok a sak, Zadok ni Ahimaaz a sak.
Ahimaaz ni Azariah a sak, Azariah ni Johanan a sak.
Johanan ni Azariah a sak. Ahni teh Solomon ni Jerusalem vah a sak e im dawk vaihma thaw a tawk.
Azariah ni Amariah a sak teh Amariah ni Ahitub a sak.

Sawl teh a tarannaw ni rek a pâlei awh teh, licung ka kathoum e ni pala hoi a ka awh teh hmâ a ca sak awh.

Sawl ni amae senehmaica ka patuem e koevah, na tahloi hah rayu nateh, pawkkayawng lah na thun. nahoeh pawiteh, vuensom ka a hoehnaw ni lung na paroum nah awh langvaih atipouh. Hateiteh, amae senehmaica ka patuem e ni thun ngai hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, a taki. Hatdawkvah, Sawl ni amahoima tahloi a vai teh a tabosin.
Senehmaica ka patuem e ni Sawl a due toe tie hah, a hmu torei teh, ahni hai amahoima tahloi hoi a kâthei van.
Sawl hoi a capanaw kathum touh a due awh.
Tanghling dawk kaawm e Isarelnaw pueng teh, a yawng awh. Sawl hoi a capanaw a due toe tie a thai awh torei teh, kho a tâco takhai awh teh, a yawng awh. Hot dawkvah Filistinnaw ni ao na awh.
A tangtho vah Filistinnaw ni a thei awh e naw dawk, senehmaica hah la hanelah a cei awh navah, Gilboa mon dawk Sawl hoi a capanaw kadout e hah a hmu awh.
Senehmaica hah a rading awh teh, a lû hoi senehmaicanaw hah meikaphawk imnaw hoi a taminaw e meikaphawknaw koe pathang hanelah kamthang a pathang awh.
A senehmaica teh amamae cathut im dawk a hruek awh teh, a lû teh dagon im dawk a vo awh.
Sawl dawk Filistinnaw ni a sak e naw hah Jabesh Gilead kaawmnaw pueng ni a thai awh torei teh,

tami tarankahawinaw ni a kamthaw sin awh teh, Sawl hoi a capa e ro hah a la awh teh, Jabesh kho lah a ceikhai awh teh, a hruhrawngnaw hah kathen kung rahim vah a pakawp awh. Hnin 7 touh thung rawcahai laihoi ao awh.
BAWIPA taranlahoi a sak e, yuemkamcu lah ao hoeh kecu dawk Sawl teh a due. Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA e lawk hah tarawi laipalah, khueyuenu koe pouknae a hei.
Hateiteh, BAWIPA koe teh pouknae a hei hoeh dawkvah, ahni hah a due sak teh, a uknaeram hah Jesi capa Devit koe a poe pouh.
\s1 Devit siangpahrang lah a sak
Isarelnaw pueng teh Hebron kho koe a tho awh. Khenhaw! kaimanaw teh na hru hoi na tak lah ka o awh.

Hnuk lae atueng dawk Sawl a bawi nah haiyah, Isarelnaw ka tâcawtkhai e hoi kâenkhai e lah na o. BAWIPA Cathut ni nang koevah, ka tami Isarel tukhoumkung lah na o vaiteh, kahrawikung lah na o han ati telah atipouh awh.

Hatdawkvah, Isarel kacuenaw pueng teh Hebron kho siangpahrang koe a tho awh teh, Devit ni Hebron kho BAWIPA e hmalah, ahnimouh hoi lawkkamnae a sak. Samuel hno lahoi BAWIPA e lawk patetlah Isarel siangpahrang hanelah Devit teh satui a awi awh.   
\s1 Devit e khopui
Devit hoi Isarelnaw pueng teh Jubusitnaw khosaknae Jerusalem lah a cei awh. Jerusalem teh Jebusitnaw khosaknae doeh.
Jebusit kho kaawmnaw ni Devit hi vah khoeroe kâen hanh, telah atipouh awh. Hateiteh, Devit ni Zion rapanim a lawp pouh teh Devit khopui tie lah ao.
Devit ni Jubusitnaw hmaloe ka tuk e teh, ransabawi hoi kahrawikung lah ao han telah ati. Hatdawkvah, Zeruiah capa Joab teh hmaloe poung lah a cei teh kahrawikung kacue lah a sak.
Devit teh rapanim thung lah kho a sak dawkvah, Devit khopui ati awh.
Millo e hmuen koehoi khopui petkâkalup lah rapan teh a kangdue. Joab ni khopui pueng hah a pathoup.

Hatdawkvah, Devit teh hoehoe a len teh, ransahu BAWIPA ahni koevah ao.   
\s1 Devit e tami a thakasainaw

Hetnaw teh Devit ni a tawn e thakaawme taminaw doeh. Isarelnaw pueng hoi ama hoi a uknaeram hanlah amamouh hoi amamouh tha a kâpoe awh teh, Isarel kong dawk BAWIPA e lawk patetlah siangpahrang o thai nahanelah kangdoutkhainaw doeh.
Hetheh Devit ni a tawn e tami athakaawme taminaw doeh. Hakmonite tami e capa Jashobeam, tami 30 touh e hu kahrawikung, tahroe a patuep teh vai touh hoi tami 3,00 ka thet e doeh.
Ahni hnukkhu hoi Aho tami Dodo e capa Eleazar tami athakaawme taminaw 3 touh dawkvah, buet touh lah ao.
Ahni teh Pasdammim e hmuen Devit koevah ao. Hawvah Filistinnaw teh, tarantuk hanelah a kamkhueng awh teh, hawvah catun hoi kakawi e tanghling ao. Taminaw pueng teh Filistinnaw e hmalah a yawng awh.
Hatei, ahnimouh teh, law lungui hmuen a la teh Filistinnaw a thei awh. Hottelah BAWIPA ni kalentoenaw, tânae a kamnue sak.
Ransa 30 touh thung dawk e tami a thakasai e tami 3 touh teh Adullam lungngoum, Devit onae lungsong koe a cathuk awh.
Hatdawkvah, Devit teh rapanim thungup ao. Filistin ransanaw teh Bethlehem vah ao awh.
Devit ni a rabuipoung teh, Bethlehem tuikhu dawk e tui, rapan longkha teng e hah ka nei hanelah na ka poe thai e awm pawiteh, ka ngaipoung eite telah a ti.

Ransa kathum touh ni Filistin ransanaw a roenae hah pat a rakan awh teh, rapan longkha teng e Bethlehem tuikhu dawk e tui hah a do awh teh, Devit koevah a thokhai awh. Hateiteh, Devit ni net ngai hoeh. BAWIPA hanelah a rabawk.
Ahni ni, Oe BAWIPA hethateh khoeroe ka net mahoeh. Athakaawme taminaw kathum touh ni a sak e hno doeh.
Joab e a nawngha Abishai teh, kathum touh thung dawk e kacue lah ao. Tami 300 touh hah tahroe hoi a thei dawkvah, tami kathum touh thung dawk e a min kamthang e lah ao.
Tami kathum touh thung dawk ahni teh kahni touh hlak oup hanelah ao. Hatdawkvah kacuepoung lah ao. Hateiteh, hmaloe e kathum touh dawkvah bawk hoeh.

Jehoiada e capa Benaiah teh, Kabzeel kho e tami thakaawme capa hno moikapap ka sak e lah ao. Ahni ni sendek patetlah athakaawme Moab tami tarankahawi e kahni touh a thei. Hahoi bout a cei teh, tadamtui a bo nah a khu dawk kaawm e sendek buet touh bout a thei.

Ka rasang katang e Izip tami dong 5 touh e hah a thei. Izip tami e kut dawk hni kawng kalawng tittouh e tahroe hah a patuep. Benaiah sonron hoi a yawng sin teh, Izip tami e kut dawk e tahroe hah a lawp teh hote tahroe hoi letlang a thei.

Tami 30 touh hlakvah bari kamcu lah ao katang. Hateiteh, hmaloe kathum touh koe bawk thai hoeh. Hahoi Devit ni ama karingkungnaw thung dawk kacuelah a ta.

\s1 Devit kabawm e ransanaw
Kish capa Sawl koehoi Devit a yawng teh Ziklag kho ao nah, ahni koe ka tho e naw teh, hetnaw hah doeh. Ahnimouh teh tarantuknae koe lah ama kabawm e tami athakaawme taminaw doeh.
Likathoumnaw lah ao awh teh, samtang ka pathui thai e, tâyai ka dei thai e, avoilah aranglah hoi ka thoum e naw lah ao awh. Ahnimanaw teh Benjamin taminaw, Sawl e a imthungnaw lah ao awh.
Ahnimouh kahrawikung lah Ahiezer doeh. Ahni hnuk Gibeah tami Shemaah casak Joash, Jeziel, Azmaveth casak Pelet, Berakah, Anathoth tami Jehu.
Tami 30 lathueng hoi 30 rahak dawk e athakaawme Gibeon tami Ishmaiah, Jeremiah hoi Jahaziel, Johanan hoi Gederath tami Jozabad.

Devit ni ahnimouh dawn hanelah a cei teh, roumnae hane dawkvah, kabawp hanelah na tho awh pawiteh, ka lungthin na poe awh han. Hateiteh, ka kut ni runae banghai sak hoeh tie na panue nalaihoi, kai pahnawt hanelah na tho awh pawiteh, mintoenaw e Cathut ni na khet vaiteh lawk na ceng awh naseh, telah atipouh.

Hottelah tami 30 touh thung dawk e kahrawikung Amasai tak dawk muitha a tho teh, Devit na tami lah ka o awh. Jesi capa nang koe lah kampang e naw doeh. Nang dawk roumnae awm naseh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, na Cathut ni na kabawp tet loe atipouh. Hatdawkvah, Devit ni ahnimouh a la teh ransahu ka hrawi e lah ao sak.

Ziklag a cei awh navah, Manassehnaw thung hoi ransa 1000 ka hrawi e Adnah hoi Jozabad, Jediael hoi Michael, Jozabad, Elihu hoi Zillethai naw teh ahni koe ao awh.
Hetnaw teh Devit taran tuk navah, kabawm e naw lah ao awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, abuemlah hoi athakaawme taminaw teh, kahrawikungnaw lah ao awh.

Hatnae tueng dawk hoi Devit kabawm hane hnin touh hoi hnin touh meng a tho awh teh, Cathut e ransahu patetlah kalenpounge ransahu lah a coung.   
\s1 Hebron e Devit e ransanaw.

Ephraim capanaw tami athakaawme hoi tarankahawi imthung dawk hoi 20, 800 touh a pha awh.

Hotnaw pueng teh taran ka tuk e, bouk ka thoum e naw lah ao awh. Devit teh Isarelnaw pueng dawkvah, siangpahrang lah ao hane lungthin buet touh lah a tawn teh, Hebron lah a cei awh. Isarel alouknaw pueng nihai, Devit teh siangpahrang lah o sak hanelah lungthin buet touh lah ao awh.
Devit koevah, hnin thum touh thung a canei awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, a hmaunawnghanaw ni a rakueng pouh e doeh.

Hothloilah, imthung hmaunawnghanaw, Issakhar, Zebulun hoi Naphtali la hoi kalauk hoi marang, maitotan naw, ca hane vaiyei, hoi thai pawnaw, misurtui hoi satuinaw, a phu awh teh, maitotan hoi tu, moikapap a thokhai awh. teh Isarel ram dawk lunghawinae a kawi.
\s1 Lawkkam thingkong bout a bankhai
Devit ni kahrawikungnaw pueng koe, 1, 000 kaukkungnaw hoi, 100 touh kaukkungnaw koe pouknae a hei.

Devit ni kamkhueng e Isarelnaw koe, ahawi na tet awh boilah, BAWIPA Cathut a ngainae awm pawiteh, Isarel ram thung e hmaunawngha kaawm e naw pueng, tengpam e kho kaawm e pueng, vaihmanaw hoi Levih taminaw hai maimouh koe cungtalah kamkhueng hanelah, coun awh sei atipouh.
Cathut e thingkong hah maimouh koe bankhai awh sei. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Sawl a bawi hoi teh, a lawkpui lah pouk awh hoeh toe telah ati.
Kamkhueng e pueng ni hottelah sak e hah hnâ rip a bo khai. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hot teh tami pueng pouknae dawk ka kalan e doeh.
Hatdawkvah, Devit ni Izip palang Shihor, hoi Hamath kâennae totouh Isarelnaw hah Kiriathjeaream e Cathut e thingkong hah bankhai hanelah a kamkhueng sak awh.
Hatdawkvah, Devit hoi tami pueng teh, Judah ram e Baalah Kiriath-Jeaream ati awh e koevah, cherubim dawkvah, ka tahung e BAWIPA min a onae lawkkam thing kong la hanelah a cei awh.
Cathut e thingkong teh, Abinadab im e hah leng ka tha hoi a ceikhai awh. Uzzah hoi a hui ni leng teh a mawng.
Devit hoi Isarelnaw pueng ni la sak na laihoi ratoung hoi tamawi hoi mawngleng hoi cecak hoi mongka hoi Cathut hmalah a thaonae puenghoi a tumkhawng awh.
Kidron cangkatinnae koe a pha awh navah, maitonaw ni thingkong a kâhuet sak dawkvah, Uzzah ni thingkong hah kuet hanelah a kut a kâyap.
BAWIPA e lungkhueknae teh Uzzah tak dawk vai touh hoi a pha teh, thingkong a kuet kecu dawkvah a thei teh, Cathut hanlah a due.
Uzzah tak dawk BAWIPA e lungkhueknae a pha dawkvah, Devit teh a lungkhuek. Hote hmuen teh sahnin totouh Perezuzzah telah a phung awh.
Hat na hnin hoi Devit ni Cathut teh a taki. Bangtelah hoi maw Cathut e thingkong teh ka bankhai thai han telah ati.
Devit ni thingkong teh Devit khopui a ma koe hrueng laipalah Git tami Obededom im vah a hruek.
Cathut e thingkong teh Git tami Obededom imthung vah thapa yung thapa yung thum touh ao. Obededom e a tawn e naw pueng teh BAWIPA ni yawhawinae a poe.
Taire siangpahrang Hiram ni, Devit koevah patounenaw a patoun. Ahni hane im sak pouh hanelah, Sidar thing hoi talungdêikathoum e, hoi im sak ka thoum e naw hah a patoun.
Isarelnaw dawk siangpahrang lah BAWIPA ni a caksak tie hah Devit ni a kâpanue. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Isarelnaw kecu dawkvah, a uknaeram hah ka rasang poung lah tawmrasang e lah ao.
Devit ni Jerusalem vah a yu alouknaw hai a la teh, ca napui tongpa moi a sak.
Jerusalem vah a sak e a canaw teh Shammua, Shobab, Nathan hoi Solomon.
Ibhar, Elishua hoi Eliphelet.
Nogah, Nepheg hoi Japhia.

\s1 Filistinnaw tânae

Filistinnaw ni Devit teh Isarelnaw e siangpahrang lah satui awi lah ao toe tie a thai awh torei teh, Filistinnaw pueng ni Devit tawng hanelah a cei awh. Devit ni a thai toteh, ahnimouh tuk hanelah a kamthaw.
Filistinnaw hah Rephaim tanghling dawk a yawng awh.
Devit ni Filistinnaw tuk hanelah ka cei han maw, ka kut dawk na poe han maw, telah BAWIPA a pacei. BAWIPA ni cet leih, ahnimouh teh na kut dawk na poe han telah atipouh.

Hatdawkvah, Baalperazim vah a cei awh teh, Devit ni ahnimouh teh a tuk teh a tâ awh. BAWIPA ni ka tarannaw teh tuicapa ka thaw e a roum sak e patetlah be a raphoe telah ati. Hatdawkvah, hote hmuen teh Baalperazim telah min a phung.
Hete hmuen koe meikaphawknaw hah a cettakhai awh. Devit ni kâ a poe teh, hmai koung koung a sawi pouh awh.
Filistinnaw teh tanghling dawk bout a yawng awh.
Hahoi Devit ni Cathut koe bout a pacei teh, ahnimanaw pâlei hanelah cet hanh. Kingkalup awh nateh, batuekung koe pawm awh.

Hahoi hettelah ao han. Batuekung e a van a cei awh e a pâlawk na thai awh toteh, tuk hanelah na tâco awh han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Filistinnaw roenae tuk hane na hmalah Cathut a tho tie hah na panue han atipouh.
Cathut ni kâ a poe e patetlah Devit ni a sak teh, Filistin e ransanaw hah, Gibeon hoi Gezer totouh a pâlei awh.
Hottelah ram pueng dawk Devit e min a kamthang teh, BAWIPA ni ama takinae hah miphun tangkuem koe a kamthang sak
\s1 Jerusalem vah thingkong a cekhai

Hatdawkvah, Devit ni Aron e casaknaw hoi Levih casaknaw hah a pâkhueng. awh.

Nangmanaw teh Levihnaw thung dawk kacuepoung lah na o awh. Isarel BAWIPA Cathut e thingkong hah ka rakueng e hmuen koevah, thokhai hanelah nama hoi na hmaunawnghanaw kamthoung awh.

Ahmaloe e dawk hai nangmouh ni na kâkayawt awh hoeh dawkvah BAWIPA Cathut ni mamouh dawk a lungkhueknae a pha sak. Bangkongtetpawiteh, amae lamthung patetlah sak hane hah ama koe pacei awh hoeh telah a ti.
Hatdawkvah, Isarel BAWIPA Cathut e thingkong hah kâkayawt hanelah vaihmanaw hoi Levihnaw hah a kamthoung awh.

\s1 Isarel hoi Judah milu touknae

Hatdawkvah, Devit ni Joab hoi a taminaw kahrawikung koe, Isarel miphun pueng Dan kho hoi Beersheba kho totouh cet awh nateh, tami nâyittouh maw tie ka panue thai nahan touk awh nateh kai koe bout na dei awh han telah atipouh.

Hatei, Joab ni siangpahrang koevah, BAWIPA ni taminaw teh a let 100 touh haiyah pungdaw sak naseh, siangpahrang ka bawipa e misa lah koung kaawm nahoehmaw, ka bawipa ni bangkongmaw hot hah panue han na ngai, bangdawkmaw Isarelnaw kâtapoe sak hanelah na sak vaw atipouh.
Hateiteh siangpahrang e lawk teh Joab ni ek thai hoeh. Hatdawkvah, Joab ni Isarel ram pueng dawk a cei teh, Jerusalem vah bout a ban.
Joab ni tami kaawm e yit touh Devit koe bout a dei pouh. Isarel ram dawk tahloi ka patuem e 1, 100, 000 touh a pha awh.
Hateiteh, Levihnaw hoi Benjaminnaw teh touk awh hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, siangpahrang e lawk teh Joab hanelah panuet a tho.
Hote kong teh Cathut ni a ngai hoeh dawkvah, Isarelnaw hah a thei.

Devit ni Cathut koe hete ka sak e dawkvah puenghoi ka payon toe. Hatei nakunghai na sanpa kai ni ka payon, kai heh na pahren nateh, na ngaithoum yawkaw ei. Bangkongtetpawiteh, pathunae hno ka sak toe telah ati.   
\s1 Devit tounnae
BAWIPA ni Devit e profet Gad koe vah,
Cet nateh, Devit koe hettelah dei pouh. Hno kathum touh nang koe na patue. Nang dawk kai ni ka sak hane buetbuet touh kârawi leih telah dei pouh telah atipouh.
Gad teh Devit koe a cei teh, BAWIPA ni hettelah a dei, na ngai e kârawi leih.

BAWIPA ni a dei e teh, kum thum touh thung takang ka tho sak maw na ngai, Nahoeh pawiteh, thapa yung thum touh tarannaw ni na pâlei maw na ngai, Nahoeh pawiteh, hnin thum touh thung Lacik ka phasak maw na ngai. Na kapatounkung koe bangtelamaw ka dei pouh han, atu kâpouk nateh, dei haw telah atipouh.
Devit ni Gad koevah, ka lung rei a thai, kho lah king a bing. BAWIPA e kut dawk ka bawt yawkaw naseh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh a len. Tami e a kut dawk teh na phat sak hanh telah atipouh.
Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA ni Isarelnaw thung lacik a pha sak teh, Isarelnaw tami 70, 000 touh a due awh.

Hahoi Jerusalem raphoe hanelah, Cathut ni kalvantami a patoun teh, raphoe hane a kâcai navah, BAWIPA ni a khet teh, hawihoehnae sak han a noe e hah bout a kâhno. Ka raphoe e kalvantami koevah, a khout toe na kut dâw hanh lawi telah atipouh teh, BAWIPA e kalvantami teh Jebusit tami Ornan e cangkatinnae teng vah a kangdue.

Devit ni kho a radoung teh, BAWIPA kalvantami tahloi a rayu nalaihoi Jerusalem koelah a nue teh, talai hoi kalvan a rahak dawk a kangdue e hah a hmu. Hatdawkvah, Devit hoi kacuenaw ni buri a kâramuk awh teh, talai dawk a tabo awh.

Devit ni Cathut koe taminaw touk hane kâ kapoekung teh kai nahoehmaw. Kai heh yonnae ka sak e, kahawihoehe poung lah hno ka sak e teh kai doeh. Hetnaw ni bangmaw a sak awh. Oe BAWIPA ka Cathut, kai hoi ka imthungnaw dawk na kut pho nateh, na taminaw ni lacik hah khang awh hanh naseh, telah ati.
Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA kalvantami ni Jebusit tami Ornan e cangkatinnae koevah Devit a cei vaiteh, BAWIPA hanelah thuengnae khoungroe kangdue sak hanelah, Devit koe dei pouh hanelah Gad koe kâ a poe.
A dei e patetlah Gad ni BAWIPA min lahoi a dei pouh e patetlah Devit teh a cei.
Ornan ni a kamlang teh kalvantami hah a hmu. Ahni koe kaawm e a capa 4 touh a kâhro. Ornan ma teh cang a katin.
Hottelah Devit ni Ornan koe a pha teh, Ornan ni a khet navah, Devit hah a hmu. Cang a katin e pak a tha teh, Devit e hmalah talai dawk a tabo.
Devit ni BAWIPA hanelah thuengnae khoungroe ka sak thai nahanelah cangkatinnae hmuen hah na poe haw. Taminaw koehoi lacik a kâkayaw thai nahanelah, ka kuepcalah a phu na poe han telah atipouh.

Ornan ni Devit koe lat yawkaw, siangpahrang ka bawipa ni ahawi na tie patetlah sak yawkaw, khenhaw! hmaisawi thuengnae sak nahanelah maitotan hoi thueng hanelah cakong, tavai hoi thueng nahanelah cakang hai na poe han. Abuemlahoi koung na poe telah atipouh.
Siangpahrang Devit ni Ornan koevah, telah nahoeh. Aphu hoi kâran han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA hanlah nange ka lat mahoeh. Banghai baw laipalah thuengnae sathei hah ka poe mahoeh atipouh.
Hatdawkvah, Devit ni hote hmuen teh Ornan koe sui shekel 600 touh hoi a ran.
Devit ni hote hmuen koe BAWIPA hanlah khoungroe a sak teh, sathei thuengnae hoi roum thuengnae sathei poenae a sak. BAWIPA a kaw teh khoungroe dawkvah kalvan lahoi hmai hoi a pato.
BAWIPA ni kalvantaminaw hah kâ a poe teh, tahloi teh a tabu dawk bout a pâseng.
Devit ni Jebusit tami Ornan e cangkatinnae koehoi BAWIPA ni na pato tie hah a panue torei teh, hawvah thueng a sak.
Hatnae tueng dawkvah, Mosi ni kahrawngum BAWIPA e lukkareiim hoi hmaisawinae khoungroe a sak e hah, Gibeon kho e hmuenrasang doeh ao rah.
Hateiteh, Cathut koe pouknae hei hanelah Devit ni a hmalah cet thai hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA e kalvantami e tahloi hah a taki.
Devit ni hetteh BAWIPA Cathut e im lah ao teh, hethateh Isarelnaw hanelah hmaisawi thuengnae khoungroe doeh telah ati.
Hatdawkvah, Devit ni Isarel ram e miphun alouke kaawm e naw hah, cungtalah pâkhueng teh, Cathut e im sak hanelah, talungdêikathoumnaw hah thaw a poe.
Devit ni longkha, tho sak nahanelah sum moikapap hoi rahum moikapap a ta pouh.
Sidar thing hai moikapap a ta pouh. Sidonnaw hoi Tairenaw ni Devit koevah, Sidar thing moikapap a sin pouh awh.

Devit ni ka capa Solomon teh a camo rah dawkvah, banghai panuek hoeh rah. A sak hane BAWIPA im teh a raim kaawm poung e, a min kamthang poung e, hoi ka lentoe e, ram pueng dawk pathang hanelah ao han. Hatdawkvah, sut ka rakueng pouh han telah ati. Devit ni a due hoehnahlan vah sut a rakueng pouh.
A capa Solomon a kaw teh, BAWIPA Isarel Cathut e im sak hanelah kâ a poe.
Devit ni a capa Solomon koevah, ka capa BAWIPA ka Cathut im hanelah im ka sak pouh hanelah ka kâcainae ao.
Hatei, nang teh thi moikapap na lawng sak. Taran kalenpoungnaw hai na tuk. Kaie mithmu vah talai van thi moikapap na lawng sak. Ka min hane im na sak mahoeh.

Khenhaw! capa na tawn vaiteh, ahni teh roumnae tami lah ao han. A tengpam e tarannaw e thung hoi roumnae ka poe han. A min teh Solomon na ti han. Ahnie se dawk Isarelnaw teh lungmawngnae hoi roumnae hoi ao han.

Ahni ni kaie min o nahane im a sak han. Ahni teh ka capa lah ao vaiteh, kai teh a na pa lah ka o han. Isarelnaw dawk uknaeram a bawitungkhung a yungyoe ka caksak han, telah BAWIPA e lawk teh kai koe a tho.
Hatdawkvah, ka capa, BAWIPA teh nang koe ao teh, na lam a cawn sak vaiteh, na dei tangcoung e patetlah nang ni nange BAWIPA Cathut e im hah na sak han.
BAWIPA ni lungangnae hoi thoumthainae na poe seh. Isarelnaw dawk uknae na poe seh. BAWIPA na Cathut e phunglawk teh na tarawi thai han.
Hottelah Isarel kong dawk phung hoi lawkcengnae BAWIPA ni Mosi koe a poe e naw hah na tarawi pawiteh, na lam a cawn han doeh. Na tha awm sak, na taranhawi sak, taket hanh, na lungpout sak hanh.

Khenhaw! sut ka rakueng tangcoung e BAWIPA e im hanelah sui talen 1, 000 hoi ngun talen 1, 000, 000 touh a ta pouh. Rahum hoi sumnaw hai moikapap lah ao toe. Thing hoi talungnaw hai ka rakueng toe. Youn na sak thai han toe.
Hahoi thaw ka tawk hane, thing ka a hane, talung ka dêi hane, imsakkathoumnaw koung ao toe.
Moikapap lah suinaw hoi ngunnaw, rahumnaw, sumnaw hai ao. Thaw nateh tawk hane youn kamtawng leih, BAWIPA teh nang koe ao atipouh.
Devit ni Isarel kahrawikungnaw pueng teh a capa Solomon kabawp awh hanelah kâ a poe.

BAWIPA nangmae Cathut teh nangmouh koe ao nahoehmaw. Hmuen tangkuem vah roumnae na poe nahoehmaw. Hete ram dawk e taminaw teh ka kut dawk na poe teh a ram hai BAWIPA hoi a taminaw hmalah tâ lah ao toe.

BAWIPA na Cathut hah tawng hanelah, na hringnae hoi na lungthin dawk tat awh. Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA lawkkam thingkong hoi Cathut e hnopai kathounge naw hah BAWIPA min lahoi sak hane im dawkvah, kâenkhai hanelah, BAWIPA Cathut e hmuen kathoung teh thaw nateh sak awh telah ati.
\s1 Levihnaw hoi vaihmanaw e thawtawknae
Devit teh a matawng toung dawkvah, a capa Solomon teh Isarel siangpahrang lah a sak awh.
Isarel kahrawikungnaw pueng hoi vaihmanaw, Levihnaw hah koung a kamkhueng sak.
Levihnaw teh kum 30 touh hoi lathueng e naw hah touk e lah ao teh, tongpa 38, 000 a pha.
Hotnaw thung dawk hoi 24, 000 teh BAWIPA e im ka sak hane naw hoi ka ring hane naw lah ao awh teh, 6000 teh kahrawikungnaw hoi lawkcengkungnaw lah ao awh.
Hahoi 4000 teh, longkha karingkungnaw lah ao awh. Alouke 4000 teh pholennae koe tumkhawng hanelah ka sak e naw, Devit ni a sak e hah a hno awh teh, BAWIPA kapholennaw lah ao awh.
Levih e capanaw thung dawk hoi a hu louklouk lah a kâkapek awh. Gershon casaknaw Kohath hoi Merari.
Ladan casaknaw teh Jehiel, Zetham hoi Joel, abuemlah kathum touh a pha awh.
Shimei casaknaw teh Shelomith hoi Haziel, Haran hoi abuemlah kathum touh a pha awh. Hetnaw teh Ladan catoun imthung kahrawikung lah ao awh.
Shimei casaknaw teh Jahath, Zina, Jeush hoi Beriah. Hetnaw pali touh teh Shimei casaknaw doeh.
Jahath teh kacuepoung lah ao. Zizah teh apâhni e lah ao. Jeush hoi Beriah teh ca pung awh hoeh. Hatdawkvah, imthung buet touh e patetlah a pouk awh.
Kohath casaknaw teh Amram, Izhar, Hebron, Uzziel hoi pali touh a pha awh.

Amram casaknaw teh Aron hoi Mosi doeh. Aron hoi a catounnaw teh, yungyoe hanelah kathounge hnonaw hah thoung sak hane, BAWIPA hmalah hmuitui sawi e thaw hah tawk vaiteh, amae min lah hoi yawhawi ka poe hanelah aloukcalah kapek e lah ao.
Cathut e tami Mosi e capanaw teh Levih miphun dawk hmai touksin e lah ao.
Mosi casak teh Gershom hoi Eliezer.
Gershom casak thung dawk hoi kacuepoung e teh Shubael doeh.
Eliezer casak lah kaawm e thung hoi kacuepoung e Rehabiah doeh. Eliezer ni ca tongpa alouke tawn hoeh. Hateiteh, Rehabiah casak teh moi a pung awh.
Izhar casak thung dawk hoi kacuepoung e teh Shelomith doeh.
Hebron casaknaw thung dawk hoi kacuepoung e teh Jeriah doeh. Apâhni e teh Amariah doeh. Apâthum e teh Jahaziel doeh. Apali e teh Jekameam doeh.
Uzziel casak dawk hoi kacuepoung e teh Mikah, apâhni e teh Isshiah doeh.
Merari casak teh Mahli hoi Mushi, Mahli casak teh Eleazar hoi Kish.
Eleazar teh ca tongpa tawn hoeh. Napui dueng doeh a tawn. Kish e capanaw ni ahnimouh teh yu lah a la awh.
Mushi casaknaw teh Mahli, Eder, Jerimoth hoi kathum touh a pha awh.
Hetnaw teh Levih capanaw dawk a imthung lah hoi touk awh e dawk, imthungnaw kahrawikung BAWIPA im sak hanelah kum 20 lathueng e thaw katawknaw lah ao awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Devit ni Jerusalem vah yungyoe kho a sak thai nahane Isarel BAWIPA Cathut ni a taminaw hah karoumcalah o thai nahan a poe e doeh.
Levihnaw ni hai lukkareiim hoi a thaw tawk nahanelah puengcangnaw kâkayawt hanelah ngai mahoeh toe, telah a ti.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Devit ni kâpoe e ao dawkvah, Levihnaw kum 20 lathueng hah touk e lah ao awh.

Hatdawkvah, Levihnaw teh Cathut e im dawk thaw ka tawk e Aron e capanaw thaw kabawp hane, longkha thung e, im khan thung e, kathounge hno pueng thoung sak hane, BAWIPA e im dawk thaw ka tawk e lah ao awh.
Pâtoum hane vaiyei hoi tavai, thueng nahane tavai kanui e, tonphuenhoehe ka rapamca e, hmai pahai e thoseh, karê e thoseh, kathoung kalen pueng hai ao.
Amom tangminlah hnintangkuem BAWIPA koe lunghawi lawk dei hanelah ao awh.
Sabbath hnin thoseh, thaparei hnin thoseh, pawi hnin thoseh, sak hane patetlah BAWIPA koe thuengnae pueng poe hanelah thaw katawknaw lah ao awh.
Hahoi, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim ka ring hane hoi, hmuen kathoung ka ring hane hoi, BAWIPA im dawk thaw ka tawk hane hmaunawngha Aron e capanaw ni sak hane pueng teh ahnimae thaw lah ao.
Aron capanaw thaw reinae teh hettelah ao. Aron casaknaw teh Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar hoi Ithamar tinaw hah doeh.
Nadab hoi Abihu teh a na pa a due hoehnahlan a due roi teh, capa tawn roi hoeh. Hatdawkvah, Eleazar hoi Ithamar ni vaihma thaw teh a tawk roi.
Devit ni Eleazar casak Zadok hoi Ithamar casak Ahimelek tinaw hoi rei ka tawk hane thaw a kapek pouh.

Ithamar casaknaw hlak vah, Eleazar casaknaw ni kahrawikung kapap lah ao awh. Eleazar casak dawk hoi imthung kahrawikungnaw 16 touh a pha awh. Ithamar casak dawk hoi imthung kahrawikungnaw 8 touh a pha awh.
Hottelah cungpam a khoe awh teh, suetalah a kârei awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Eleazar casaknaw hoi Ithamar casaknaw dawk hmuen kathoung dawk e kahrawikung hoi Cathut e im hanelah kahrawikung lah ao awh.

\s1 La kahrawikungnaw
Hahoi teh, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun casak tangawn ni ratoung hoi tamawi, cecaknaw hoi tumkhawng hanelah Devit hoi ransabawinaw ni lengkaleng thaw a poe awh.

Jeduthun dawk hoi Jeduthun casaknaw teh Gedaliah, Zeri, Isaiah, Hashabiah, Mattithiah hoi taruk touh a pha awh. Ratoung hoi BAWIPA koe lunghawinae lawk kadeikung a na pa e kâ rahim kaawm e naw doeh.

\s1 Miphun kahrawikungnaw
Isarel miphunnaw dawkvah, Reuben miphun dawk hoi Zikhri capa Eliezer teh bawi kalen lah ao. Simeon miphunnaw hanelah Maakah capa Shephatiah,
Levih miphunnaw hanelah Kemuel capa Hashabiah, Aron miphunnaw hanelah Zadok,
Judah miphunnaw hanelah Devit e hmaunawnghanaw thung dawk hoi Elihu, Issakhar miphunnaw hanelah Michael capa Omri,

Ephraim casak miphunnaw hanelah Azaziah capa Hosi, Manasseh casak tangawn naw hanelah Pedaiah capa Joel,

Dan miphunnaw hanelah Jeroham capa Azarel. Hotnaw teh Isarel miphun kahrawikungnaw lah ao awh.
Hateiteh, Devit ni kum 20 rahim naw hah touk hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Isarel teh kalvan e âsi yit touh ka pung sak han telah BAWIPA ni yo a la dei toe.

Zeruiah capa Joab ni touk hanelah ati eiteh, boeba touk thai hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, milu touk kecu dawkvah, Isarelnaw dawk a lungkhueknae a pha. A touk awh e yit touh siangpahrang Devit ni setouknae dawk thut e lah awm hoeh.   
\s1 Ram kahrawikung alouknaw
Siangpahrang e hnopai ka ring e teh, Adiel capa Azmaveth doeh. Law dawk hai, khopui dawk hai, khote dawk hai, hnoim dawk hai, hnopainaw kakhenyawnkung teh Uzziah capa Jonathan doeh.
Laikawk kanawknaw ka khenyawnkung lah Kelub capa Ezri doeh.
Misur takha kakhenyawnkung lah Ramathit tami Shimei doeh. Misur takha thung e misurkatin e kakhenyawnkung teh Shipmit tami Zabdi doeh.
Tanghling dawk kaawm e olive thing hoi thailahei kungnaw kakhenyawnkung lah Gaderi tami Baalhanan doeh. Satuinaw tanae kakhenyawnkung lah Joash doeh.
Sharon dawk ka pâ e saringnaw kakhenyawnkung lah Sharon tami Shitrai doeh. Tanghling dawk e saringnaw kakhenyawnkung lah Adlai capa Shaphat doeh.
Kalauknaw kakhenyawnkung lah Ishmael tami Obil doeh. Lanaw kakhenyawnkung lah Meronoth tami Jedeiah doeh.
Tuhunaw ka khenyawnkung lah Hagri tami Jaziz doeh. Hotnaw pueng teh Devit e hnopai khenyawnkung lah ao awh.
Devit e a napu Jonathan teh a lungkaang poung e hoi, cakathoum e, kho ka pouk thai e tami lah ao. Hakmonite capa Jehiel teh siangpahrang e capanaw kacangkhaikung lah ao.
Ahithophel teh siangpahrang khokhankhaikung lah ao. Arki tami Hushai teh siangpahrang e huiko lah ao.
Ahithophel hnukkhu teh Benaiah capa Jehoiada hoi Abiathar doeh. Joab te siangpahrang e ransanaw ka hrawi e doeh.

Devit ni Isarel kahrawikungnaw pueng, miphun tangkuem dawk e kahrawikungnaw hoi siangpahrang thaw tawknae dawk hoi ouk kâhlai e kahrawikungnaw ransa 1, 000 kauknaw, 100 kauknaw, siangpahrang hoi a canaw ni a tawn e hnopainaw pueng ka khenyawnnaw thakaawme taminaw hoi tami athakaawme taminaw pueng hah Jerusalem vah a kaw awh.

Siangpahrang Devit ni a kangdue teh, ka hmaunawngha hoi ka taminaw ka lawk thai awh haw. BAWIPA lawkkam thingkong tanae hoi maimae Cathut khok tanae im ka sak han telah ka pouk e hah hote sak nahane hai moikapap ka tawn toe.
Hateiteh, Cathut ni nang teh taran ka tuk e hoi thi ka lawng sak e lah na o dawkvah, kaie ka min onae im na sak mahoeh telah ati.

Hat nakunghai Isarel BAWIPA Cathut ni apa imthungnaw dawk hoi Isarel siangpahrang lah o hane na rawi. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Judah teh kaukkung lah a rawi teh, Judah miphun thung dawk hoi, apa imthung e capanaw dawk hoi, Isarelnaw dawkvah siangpahrang lah o hane teh a ngainae doeh.
Hatdawkvah, ka capanaw thung dawk hoi BAWIPA ni ca tongpa moikapap na poe. Isarelnaw dawk BAWIPA e uknaeram bawitungkhung dawk tahung hanelah ka capa Solomon teh a rawi toe.
Hatdawkvah, kai koe ka imthung hoi ka thongma ka kangdout sak hane teh, na capa Solomon doeh. Ahni teh ka capa lah ao hane ka rawi toung dawkvah, a na pa lah ka o han.
Hothloilah kâpoelawknaw hoi, ka lawkcengnae yuemkamcu lah awm pawiteh, a uknaeram hah a yungyoe ka caksak han. Sahnin e patetlah pou tarawi pawiteh telah ati.

Hatdawkvah, hete kahawi e ram hah na coe han. Ca catounnaw hanelah yungyoe e râw lah na coe thai nahane BAWIPA e tamihu Isarelnaw pueng e mithmu hoi Cathut e hnâthainae dawk, BAWIPA na Cathut ni kâpoelawknaw hah tang nateh, pâkuem awh.

Hahoi ka capa Solomon, na pa Cathut hah panuek nateh yuemkamcu e lungthin hoi lungthocalah hoi a thaw tawk pouh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni lungthin dawk pouknae naw pueng, noe e naw pueng hah be a panue thai. Ama hah na tawng pawiteh na hmu han. Hateiteh, na kamlang takhai pawiteh, yungyoe na pahnawt han.
Atu pouk haw, bangkongtetpawiteh, hmuen kathoung hane im sak hanlah BAWIPA ni na rawi e lah na o. Tha kâlat nateh, hot teh sak telah atipouh.
Hatdawkvah, Devit ni a capa Solomon teh Bawkim hoi alawilae im hoi hnoimnaw hoi, a thung e khan hoi lungmanae tungkhung meilamnaw hah a poe.

Muitha ni a tawn sak e lungngailawk a pâpho sak e naw pueng, BAWIPA e im kalup thung e thongma meilamnaw hoi tengpam rakhan kaawm e naw pueng e meilam hoi Cathut im e hnopai cawng nahane im meilamnaw hoi, ya e hnonaw ta nahane im meilam hah a poe.
Vaihmanaw hoi Levihnaw teh, amamae ahu thung lengkaleng ao awh nahanelah, im e meilam hoi BAWIPA e im dawk thaw tawk nahane pueng, puengcangnaw pueng meilam totouh.
Thaw tawk nahanelah hlaam phunkuep, sui hlaam hanelah hno hane sui hoi thaw tawk nahanelah ngun hlaam hanelah a panki e yit touh ngun hoi,

Sui hmaiimkhoknaw hoi sui hmaiimnaw a panki e yit touh sui hno hane hoi, hmaiimkhok hoi hmaiim hanelah a panki e yit touh hno hane hoi, hmaiimkhok nahanelah hno a panki e yit touh hno hane ngun hmaiimkhok a panki e yit touh hno hane yit touh hoi.
Vaiyei hung nahane caboi, buet touh rip hanelah sui a panki e yit touh hoi, ngun caboi hanelah a panki e yit touh.
Kathounge sui moi sonae sum kut hoi, rahum, manang, suimanang khom hoi manang khom buet touh rip dawk a panki e yit touh hoi,
kathounge sui hoi sak e hmuitui hmaisawinae khoungroe hane hoi cherubim ni a rathei kadai teh, BAWIPA lawkkam thingkong kayo e kamnuenae meilam patetlah sak hane a panki e yit touh suinaw hoi.
Devit ni, a sakyoenaw hoi a pouk tangcoung e kamceng sak hanelah, BAWIPA ni amamae kut roeroe hoi a thut e roup lah ao telah atipouh.

Devit ni a capa Solomon koevah, tha kâlat nateh taran kahawicalah awm haw. Hot teh sak, taket hanh. na lungpout hanh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Jehovah Cathut ka Cathut teh nang koe ao. BAWIPA im dawk e thaw hah a cum hoehroukrak teh, nang na cettakhai mahoeh atipouh.

Hahoi, khenhaw! Cathut e im dawk thaw phunkuep ka tawk e vaihmanaw hoi Levihnaw ao awh teh, thaw tawknae kathoumnaw, lungthocalah hoi kabawmnaw hah nang koe pou ao han. Kahrawikungnaw hoi tami pueng ni kâ na poe e pueng a tarawi awh han telah atipouh.
\s1 Bawkim sak nahane poehno

Hahoi siangpahrang Devit ni taminaw koevah, Cathut ni a rawi e ka capa Solomon hah, a camo rah, a hmu thai e awm hoeh. A tawk hane teh a len poung. Bangkongtetpawiteh, bawkim teh tami hane tho hoeh niteh, BAWIPA Cathut hane doeh.

Hatdawkvah, ka Cathut im hane sui hnonae dawk sui, ngun hnonae dawk ngun, rahum hnonae dawk rahum, sum hnonae dawk sum, thing hnonae dawk thingnaw hah be ka rakueng toe. A mei pathoup nahanelah, onyx talung pangaw hoi a meikahawi e talungpangawnaw hoi, pathoup nahane talung a phukaawm e a phunphun hoi talungpangawnaw hai moikapap a ta toe
Hothloilah ka Cathut e im teh sak ngainae kalen poung lah ao dawkvah, kamae hnopai sui hoi ngunnaw hai im kathoung hanelah be ka rakueng e naw hloilah, ka Cathut im hanelah ka poe toe.
Hahoi tapang sak nahane ophir sui talen 3,000 hoi kathounge ngun talen 7,000.
Hnonae a phunphun dawk, kathoumnaw ni a hno hane, sui hno hane dawk sui, ngun hno nahane dawk ngun. Sahnin BAWIPA hanelah lunghawicalah poe pasoung e na yit touh maw ao telah a ti.
Hottelah imthungkhu kahrawikung Isarel miphun ka hrawi naw hoi, 1,000 kauknaw hoi, 100 touh kauknaw, siangpahrang thaw ka tawk e kahrawikungnaw hoi lunghawicalah hoi a poe awh.
Cathut e im saknae dawkvah sui talen 5,000 hoi Darik 10, 000 hoi rahum talen 18, 000, sum talen 100, 000 a poe awh.
Talung phu kaawmnaw ni Gershon tami Jehiel ni a khetyawt e BAWIPA e hno dawk a ta awh.

Hatdawkvah, taminaw teh a lung hroung a hawi poung awh. Pouknae buet touh dawk lunghawinae, BAWIPA hno a poe awh dawkvah, Siangpahrang Devit hai a lung hroung ahawi.   
\s1 Devit ni Cathut a pholen
Hatdawkvah, Devit ni tamipueng e hmalah BAWIPA a pholen. Kaimae BAWIPA Cathut, nang teh yungyoe hoi yungyoe totouh pholennae awm seh.

Oe BAWIPA na lennae, na bahu, na bawilennae, na tânae, hoi na taluenae teh namae doeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kalvan hoi talai dawk kaawmnaw pueng, namae doeh. Oe BAWIPA uknaeram teh nama e doeh. Nang teh bangpuengpa dawk a Lathueng Poung lah na o.
Tawntanae hoi barinae teh nama koehoi ka tho e naw doeh. Bangpuengpa na uk teh, na thaonae hoi hnotithainae naw hah na kut dawk ao. Na kut dawk tami pueng lentoe saknae hoi thasainae hah ao.
Hatdawkvah, kaimae Cathut, nama koe lunghawinae lawk ka dei. Ka lentoe e na min teh ka pholen awh.

Hatei, tami bangpatet e lah maw ka o teh, ka taminaw hai bang lah maw ao awh teh, hete hnonaw heh lunghawicalah hoi a poe thai awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hnonaw pueng heh nama koehoi ka tâcawt e naw lah ao teh, nama koe e doeh kaimouh ni letlang na poe awh.

Kaimae mintoenaw patetlah kaimouh teh na hmalah imyin, tami koe kho ka sak e patetlah doeh ka o awh. Het talai van ka hring nathung e a hninnaw teh tâhlip thung e patetlah doeh ao. Ngaihawinae banghai awm hoeh.
Oe Jehovah, kaimouh e Cathut na tamikathoungnaw hanlah im ka sak nahanelah, hete hno sut ka rakueng e hnonaw heh na kut dawk hoi ka tâcawt e lah ao teh namae lah koung ao.

Ka Cathut, nama ni lungthin ouk na tanouk teh lannae teh na lunghawinae lah ao tie hah ka panue. Kai ni hete hnonaw pueng heh lungthin katang hoi lunghawicalah hoi na poe. Atu hivah na taminaw ni lunghawicalah hoi a poe e naw hai ka hmu navah, ka lunghawi awh tangngak.
Oe BAWIPA, kaimae na pa Abraham, Isak, Isarel Cathut, na taminaw ni het patet e lungthin pou a tawn thai nahanelah, a lungthin hah nama hanelah caksak haw.

Hahoi ka capa Solomon heh kâpoelawknaw, na panuesaknaenaw, hoi na phunglawknaw tarawi hane, hotnaw pueng teh sak hane hoi, ka rakueng tangcoung e im hah sak hane, yuemkamcu e lungthin poe ei telah Devit ni atipouh.

Hahoi Devit ni kamkhueng e taminaw pueng koe atuvah, BAWIPA na Cathut teh pholen awh telah ati. Hottelah tamihupui ni a mintoenaw e BAWIPA Cathut teh a pholen awh teh BAWIPA hoi siangpahrang e hmalah a lûsaling awh teh a tabut awh.

Hahoi a tangtho vah BAWIPA koe hmaisawi thuengnae sak hanelah maitotan 1000, hoi tutan 1000, tuca 1000, hoi sathei poenae hoi Isarelnaw pueng hane sathei poenae moikapap lah a poe awh.   
\s1 Solomon a bawinae

Hatnah hnin vah lunghawinae kalen poung hoi BAWIPA e hmalah a canei awh. Apâhni e dawk Devit capa Solomon teh siangpahrang lah ao sak awh teh, kahrawikung lah ao nahanelah BAWIPA e hmalah satui a awi awh. Hahoi vaihma lah kaawm hane Zadok hah satui a awi awh.
Hottelah Solomon teh BAWIPA e bawitungkhung dawk a na pa Devit e a yueng siangpahrang lah a tahung. A lamcawn teh, Isarelnaw pueng ni a lawk teh a ngâi pouh awh.
Kahrawikungnaw pueng hoi athakaawme taminaw pueng hoi, siangpahrang Devit e capa alouknaw pueng hah siangpahrang Solomon koe a kâpoe awh.

Hottelah BAWIPA ni Solomon teh Isarelnaw pueng e mithmu dawk a kamsawng sak. Isarel ram dawk ahni hoehnahlan siangpahrangnaw thung dawk apinihai a coe boihoeh e taluenae hah a coe sak.   
\s1 Devit e a lairui
Isarelnaw a uk nathung teh kum 40 touh a pha. Hebron vah kum 7 a uk teh Jerusalem vah kum 33 touh a uk.
A kum kacuepoung lah matawng totouh a hring teh a hring nathung a tawnta e hoi pholennae, oupnae hoi a due. A capa Solomon ni amae yueng lah a uk.
Khenhaw! siangpahrang Devit kong teh, kamtawngnae koehoi a pout totouh kahmawtkung Samuel cauk dawk profet Nathan e cauk dawk, kahmawtkung Gad e cauk naw dawk hai a thut awh na a.
A uknaeram pueng hoi, a bawilennae naw pueng hoi, ama hai Isarelnaw, ramnaw pueng a uknae dawkvah, ka tho e hno pueng teh ka kuepcalah thut e lah ao.
